name: Odd Garden
thesis: An eccentric botanical gathering around a plain writing table: nine small human contributions become one unexpected specimen worth keeping.

type.displayRole: Eccentric large invitation and short page headings only; 400/600 locally bundled weights.
type.bodyRole: Usable sentence-case labels, literal recovery copy and long human names; generous 1.5 line-height.
type.poemRole: Figtree 1.2–1.65rem, complete lines together and an always-readable full author legend when attribution is shown.

principles: Plan before code: pale-green open field; deep-green ink; white task sheet; sun/orchid only on original art and supplementary state. No cream, clay, texture or stock imagery.
Plan before code: one spatial metaphor, the specimen table. The cast occupies one asymmetric edge at arrival, gathers in the lobby/wait, and leaves the writing input alone.

Pre-build critique: a serif poem, floating leaves and a growth meter would make this a generic wellness journal. Replaced them with plain Figtree poems, a gawky original mushroom and literal word-count marks.
Spend whimsy on original line art, not on metaphorical controls. Write, Send line, Read, Keep private and Share remain literal.
Preserve the whole nine-line poem. The outward botanical frame marks completion but never delivers content sequentially.
Human-only words, only previous line while writing, no prompts, scores, artificial writers, rewards, collected plants or new game modes.
Names and distinct shapes identify people; selected colors and sound are always supplementary.
Privacy and accessibility are composition constraints, not settings added after the theme.
workflow: Start or join without account creation. Name is required; companion shape is optional. DEMO and the QR SKETCH ONLY fixture are visibly non-live.
Gather 2–8 people in a named cast. Host Start is distinct from participant Waiting. A labeled sketch-only host-start action lets a single reviewer traverse the join path.

Write all nine rounds with exact 1,2,3,4,5,4,3,2,1 counts and a 500-character limit. Only one carried line appears. The core sketch stores only the reviewer’s own typed lines; synthetic fallback poems are separately labeled.
Accepted state shows Your line is in and one tiny sprout. A labeled next-sketch action advances illustrative waiting rather than pretending other people submitted.
The reading circle deliberately opens a whole poem. All nine complete lines appear at once, one brief outward frame, a human reader, persistent attribution, Done reading and reread.
Private recap provides replay, another game, lobby and exit. Favorites are personal bookmarks, never a crowned winner.
Sharing explicitly explains public text and author scope and has confirm/cancel/error/revoke state specimens. The offline prototype never publishes a URL or pretends clipboard delivery activated one.

Real browser SVG download and print can export synthetic/full locally typed poems; file outcomes stay browser-owned. Provider account and native share internals are acknowledged external boundaries, not working fake dialogs.

The controls cover every stable inventory ID via surface/id/state/mode/reduced/embed queries. Embedded comparison hides only exploration chrome, not game navigation or the synthetic-sketch disclosure.
tradeoffs: Metaphor risk: a garden can sound like therapy, growth progress or a collectible economy. Literal game verbs and deliberately odd anatomy counter this; there are no growth rewards or writing prompts.
Distraction risk: the cast could watch or judge a slow writer. During composition the large art disappears; waiting uses neutral static statuses, not faces expressing urgency.
Identity risk: serif plus pale green can become an austere journal. The asymmetric gawky cast, clear white forms and Figtree full poem are the deliberate counterweights.
Artifact risk: specimen can imply public cataloguing. Private to this group is explicit; saving and public sharing are separate, and unavailable previews contain no human words.
Character risk: four silhouettes repeat in an eight-person room. Visible full names remain the identity; shape never claims uniqueness or personality traits.

The offline prototype deliberately does not claim connected accounts, native share publication, real room codes, QR invitations or multiplayer timing. Those require Main’s real rendered integration verification.

Post-build source critique, not visual evidence: the strongest distinction is the outside-edge botanical gathering and plain specimen table. White-sheet density and illustration scale still require Main’s desktop, 375×667 and 390×844 rendered comparison before any production selection.
All visual/runtime validation is reserved for Main as assigned. No browser observation, build, test, lint, formatter or service launch is claimed here.

views.composition: An open field bounded by a compact curling-sprig wordmark and a quiet footer; white is reserved for tasks rather than dozens of nested cards.
views.hierarchy: One task in the center, literal navigation at the perimeter, and a persistent synthetic-sketch disclosure.
views.interaction: Home, poems, help and comfort remain keyboard-operable; connected account controls are not fabricated in local mode.
views.mobile: The wordmark and three short utilities fit above an in-flow main; artwork yields before text at 375px.
views.motion: No entrance choreography or background loops.

views.composition: A large left-aligned invitation balances one eccentric original botanical cast at the right edge; a three-part rules strip sits below the action pair.
views.hierarchy: The unexpected poem is the headline; Start a room and Join a room are the only primary choices; the actual nine-word shape explains the game.
views.interaction: Both actions begin the core sketch without account creation, settings or a character gate.
views.mobile: The headline stays prominent, actions share one row, and the art becomes a short edge vignette above a stacked explainer.
views.motion: The illustration is still; delight comes from its anatomy, not movement.
views.copy: Get a few people together. Pass a line around.

views.composition: A short invitation and one small mushroom face a generous, plain white name sheet; an optional four-shape companion row is inside the sheet.
views.hierarchy: Name first, literal create action next, optional expression beneath the name. No room settings are invented.
views.interaction: Whitespace-only names cannot create a room; pending disables submission; errors retain the entered name and allow retry.
views.mobile: Intro compresses above the form; artwork disappears; the action scrolls with its input rather than hiding behind the keyboard.
views.motion: No loading spinner performance or stamped form entrance.
views.copy: A name your friends will recognize. You can stay a guest.

views.composition: The host sheet becomes code then pen name, with the same generous geometry; a twig companion only occupies the outside margin.
views.hierarchy: Invitation code, name, Join sketch room; the non-live DEMO label is explicitly not a real invitation.
views.interaction: Four letters normalize to uppercase; Enter on code focuses name; errors remain beside the form; direct invitation variants keep a read-only code specimen.
views.mobile: A single column preserves label order, large input targets and in-flow submit with a phone keyboard.
views.motion: Focus moves immediately, without sliding the entire form.
views.copy: A pen name and an invitation are all you need.

views.composition: An open, uneven row of named botanical people sits on one ground line; a separate invitation note holds code and room tools.
views.hierarchy: People and the host-owned Start action dominate; code is distinct, while close/leave stay secondary.
views.interaction: One-person state disables start; host/participant and failure states are explicit; tools expose invitation, presentation and close.
views.mobile: Invitation moves above the cast; names wrap; start remains after the real roster in normal document flow.
views.motion: One optional tiny arrival settle, never stagger-hidden names.

views.composition: A full-width invitation table puts code and a labeled QR specimen beside a larger, stable named cast.
views.hierarchy: The invitation is readable from across the room; attendance follows; exit remains visible.
views.interaction: Open the sketch join form or leave presentation; QR encodes SKETCH ONLY and cannot masquerade as a live room.
views.mobile: The table stacks without clipping the code or exit; the presentation is not desktop-only.
views.motion: A static Just arrived label may mark arrivals; no moving seats.

views.composition: One clean white writing sheet with a compact round strip, only the carried line, a generous textarea and an attached in-flow submit area.
views.hierarchy: Exact word target, only previous line, your input, count and Send line; the cast is removed.
views.interaction: Rounds enforce 1,2,3,4,5,4,3,2,1 whitespace-delimited words and a 500-character limit; the draft remains on retry and offline; accepted state follows submission only.
views.mobile: Plain document flow lets the keyboard coexist with input and action; long words wrap and no decorative edge occupies the editing area.
views.motion: No ready pulse or moving word chips; one tiny post-acceptance sprout belongs to the next state.
views.copy: Only the next writer sees this line.

views.composition: A small sprout sits above the acceptance sentence; the named cast gathers below on a shared ground line rather than a performance meter.
views.hierarchy: Your line is in first, then who remains and the current round. A sketch-only next action makes simulation explicit.
views.interaction: Ready, loading, away, active and submitted states remain textual; host ending returns to the lobby without revealing partial poems.
views.mobile: The acceptance and 3-person cast stack; names stay readable at long lengths and no input is hidden under fixed controls.
views.motion: A single 450ms acknowledgement; no ambient breathing or repeated growth.
views.copy: It is safely out of your hands.

views.composition: A quiet twig and explicit Watching explanation occupy the waiting composition; no empty writing field implies an assignment.
views.hierarchy: Not writing this game is the essential status; the coming full reveal is the next meaningful destination.
views.interaction: Spectators are excluded from the writing count and can inspect the completed reveal; ordinary writing begins next game.
views.mobile: One column with an obvious entrance exit and a full-width reveal example action.
views.motion: Static presence, no pulse demanding participation.

views.composition: A human reader assignment on a plain note faces an ordered named reading list; complete poems are opened deliberately.
views.hierarchy: Your turn to read, Reveal and read, then the running order; a stepped-in reader is a recovery, not a new game mode.
views.interaction: Unrevealed, pending, error, spectator and reread states are represented; reveal opens the entire poem; presentation and private recap remain distinct.
views.mobile: Assignment and order stack; every reader name wraps and controls retain 48px targets.
views.motion: No theatrical waiting: focus announces the reader before a complete poem is displayed.

views.composition: A complete white specimen card holds all nine lines; the reader and actions live in a narrow external rail, never between lines.
views.hierarchy: Human poem first, reader next, Done reading, private favorite and artifact actions last.
views.interaction: The reader opens or rereads the same complete composition; persistent author names can be toggled; no per-line progression exists.
views.mobile: The complete poem precedes the reader controls; all nine lines remain together in scroll flow, with a complete author legend below.
views.motion: One outward 620ms botanical frame, then stillness; reduced motion shows its final frame immediately.

views.composition: A generously set full poem fills the shared table; reader caption and exit remain above, rather than beside individual lines.
views.hierarchy: Poem, reader, finish, then running order; no slides or typewriter reading.
views.interaction: Empty shows waiting for reader, active shows the whole poem, and Finish returns to the reading circle.
views.mobile: Presentation scales down to a single readable column with wrapping lines and a visible exit.
views.motion: One complete-frame bloom; never sequential lines.

views.composition: A deliberately uneven pair of complete specimen cards sits below a private-saving explanation and a decisive Play again action.
views.hierarchy: Keep/read the human words first; replay and lobby/exit are clear; sharing is separate and explicitly public.
views.interaction: Any participant can continue in the sketch; poem reread, private favorite, sharing confirmation, lobby and exit remain distinct.
views.mobile: The specimens become one long column; privacy text is not truncated to make room for the action.
views.motion: Remove leader crowns, confetti and rankings; the collection is still.

views.composition: An isolated plain recovery sheet and a small twig provide an honest destination without showing a stale room roster.
views.hierarchy: Unavailable explanation and Return to join; no room code or poem content is inferred.
views.interaction: Missing, closed, expired and nonmember states share safe wording; user can rejoin with a fresh invitation.
views.mobile: The recovery sheet is a scrollable part of the page, not an immovable overlay.
views.motion: No error stamp, blur or bouncing 404.
views.copy: Ask your host for a fresh invitation.

views.composition: A bounded recovery note replaces only the failing room surface; the visual identity and route out remain stable.
views.hierarchy: What failed, draft-preservation truth, restore action, home exit.
views.interaction: Initial loading differs from room failure; retry restores the sketch lobby; unknown room state is explained rather than coerced into gameplay.
views.mobile: No full-screen overlay that hides browser controls or clips recovery copy at large text.
views.motion: Immediate, static recovery content.

views.composition: Guest recovery uses the same generous field-note geometry as entry, without an account promotion or specimen tease.
views.hierarchy: Guest connection status, retained progress, retry, home.
views.interaction: Loading and error are separate; retry retries the guest path rather than implying an account is required.
views.mobile: One column and a reachable native button even at 200% text.
views.motion: Static incomplete ring and a specific busy sentence.
views.copy: You do not need to create an account to try again.

views.composition: A full-width inline, high-contrast notice sits above the existing writing sheet, which remains editable and stationary.
views.hierarchy: Connection truth first; a draft is never presented as accepted before delivery.
views.interaction: Offline, reconnecting, restored and normally-hidden states are distinct; reconnect keeps the local draft.
views.mobile: The notice pushes content in flow instead of covering the textarea or phone submit area.
views.motion: No countdown or moving network indicator; polite status only.

views.composition: A quiet update note above the current task offers a deliberate refresh rather than an automatic page replacement.
views.hierarchy: New version explanation, draft warning, user-controlled refresh.
views.interaction: A known mismatch shows the note; empty/unknown state shows no notice; refresh is explicit and fail-neutral checks do not invent stale state.
views.mobile: Wrap the message and action into two rows; do not float over writing.
views.motion: No reload animation or surprise focus movement.
views.copy: Finish or keep your draft before refreshing.

views.composition: An open collection with factual statistics, a guest-preservation strip and uneven full-readable specimen previews rather than an identical card dashboard.
views.hierarchy: Saved poems and private favorites come first; account status explains storage, not an upgrade gate.
views.interaction: Loading uses no invented counts; empty invites play; favorite failure retains prior state; each poem opens its complete detail.
views.mobile: Two columns become one; first/second cards lose offsets when space is scarce.
views.motion: No hover-only metadata, stagger or card lift.

views.composition: The completed specimen sits in page flow with complete author legend and artifact actions outside its border.
views.hierarchy: Poem and attribution before favorite, sharing, download, print and reversible public-link control.
views.interaction: Loading does not leak text; participant/private/public-enabled states retain the appropriate controls; revoke is explicit.
views.mobile: All author names wrap below the poem; actions wrap below the card rather than entering a hidden overflow.
views.motion: Author labels stay until dismissed, not a timed flash.

views.composition: Authorized public content uses the same clean complete specimen; unavailable content replaces it entirely with neutral branding.
views.hierarchy: Permission precedes any poem or name; public readers do not see participant favorite or revoke controls.
views.interaction: Pending, private, revoked and unavailable states reveal no text; authorized sample exposes download/print/share boundary.
views.mobile: The complete poem wraps naturally with its full author legend and ordinary route home.
views.motion: No suspense animation that suggests private text is about to leak.
views.copy: This poem is private or unavailable.

views.composition: A plain confirmation sheet faces a short explanation; there is no fake themed operating-system share dialog.
views.hierarchy: Anyone with the link can read poem and authors; saving privately is explicitly different.
views.interaction: Confirm previews public state and offers a return to the poem. Cancel returns without changing existing visibility; no live URL is generated by the offline sketch.
views.mobile: Privacy explanation appears before a full-width confirm action and equally reachable cancel.
views.motion: No automatic celebration for publication; feedback is literal.

views.composition: The same privacy sheet expands its scope to every poem and every author in the set.
views.hierarchy: Whole-set disclosure dominates; sharing a recap cannot look like privately saving one poem.
views.interaction: Confirm and cancel return to the recap through explicit actions; cancellation preserves existing publication state, with no silent activation or synthetic copied link.
views.mobile: All scope language stays visible above confirmation; the card is scrollable at large text.
views.motion: Static confirmation, no group burst.

views.composition: A complete specimen preview precedes a real local SVG download; the exported artwork is deliberately plain and all-attributed.
views.hierarchy: Full human text and author names, then save action; the private/public distinction remains explicit.
views.interaction: The sketch creates an original synthetic image with current light/dark palette; browser download owns file handling and cancellation.
views.mobile: Preview reflows; downloaded dimensions grow with wrapped text rather than cropping long lines.
views.motion: No saving animation masks work; browser handoff is reported, not guessed.

views.composition: A dedicated preview makes the final ink-on-white artifact visible before invoking the real browser print dialog.
views.hierarchy: Complete poem and all names; all app controls and decorative frames disappear in print.
views.interaction: Native print owns accepted/canceled outcomes; the sketch never claims a PDF was saved.
views.mobile: Reading preview remains a normal one-column page; print pagination protects complete poems where possible.
views.motion: No print ceremony.

views.composition: A public heading and complete attributed specimen collection give every poem equal readability; no favorite winner dominates.
views.hierarchy: Explicitly shared set, each complete poem, author legend, then native print and join/start links.
views.interaction: Private/unavailable state shows the safe not-found composition; export opens native print and does not fabricate PDF status.
views.mobile: The collection is a single sequential column, never a horizontal carousel with hidden poems.
views.motion: No auto-advancing collection or entrance stagger.

views.composition: A plain optional-account sheet and a small outside mushroom preserve guest-first entry; no credentials are collected in the disconnected sketch.
views.hierarchy: Truthful account availability, Play as guest, then integrated-provider design boundary.
views.interaction: Actual local state says Accounts are not connected; provider-managed identity, verification and recovery are described as an integration boundary, not simulated security.
views.mobile: Account action becomes the first form-like surface, while illustration disappears.
views.motion: No login animation or endless spinner for unavailable services.

views.composition: The optional account sheet explains preservation without turning guest entry into an identity performance.
views.hierarchy: Account availability and guest continuation before any upgrade language.
views.interaction: Connected provider creation/OTP/errors would retain native security semantics; the sketch exposes honest local account unavailability instead.
views.mobile: One column, no desktop showcase burden on the phone.
views.motion: Static, no signup reward sprout.

views.composition: A simple account-transfer sheet presents completing or retained-progress recovery, never a celebratory redirect screen.
views.hierarchy: Transfer status and assurance about the original guest poems, then Retry or Go home.
views.interaction: Loading, migration failure, retry and unavailable-account branches are visible; the sketch never migrates actual credentials.
views.mobile: A small scrollable message sheet holds both escape and retry.
views.motion: Static busy ring; focus is not held through animation.
views.copy: Your guest poems have not moved yet.

views.composition: Identity is a name-first sheet with a single chosen companion and browser-session status; no new editable account profile is invented.
views.hierarchy: Pen name, guest/account provenance, then optional companion and account boundary.
views.interaction: Guest/local mode is truthful; account management remains provider-owned, not a fake working button.
views.mobile: Long names wrap at any character and the companion never squeezes the name into ellipsis.
views.motion: No grayscale-to-color hover trick.

views.composition: A compact account-availability sheet preserves the global identity language but hands security management to the real provider when present.
views.hierarchy: Local guest truth and safe navigation; no fabricated signed-in popover.
views.interaction: Disconnected mode offers guest play; integrated management, recovery and sign-out remain an external provider boundary.
views.mobile: The account surface is bounded and scrollable; it never requires a wide desktop popover.
views.motion: No profile-image filter or animated account flyout.

views.composition: One accessible plain modal explains the true nine-line word shape with literal numbered rules and no decorative writing prompt.
views.hierarchy: How to join, blind passing, exact shape, then complete aloud reveal.
views.interaction: Close, Got it, Escape and backdrop restore trigger focus; focus remains within the modal while open.
views.mobile: The modal scrolls inside the viewport at 375px and large text; no close action is offscreen.
views.motion: Open immediately, no slide or faded hidden first paragraph.
views.copy: Nine lines. Nobody sees it all.

views.composition: A small Comfort panel groups readable light/dark/system choice, reduced motion and separate sound activation.
views.hierarchy: Palette first, then reduced motion, sound state, volume and a deliberate test cue.
views.interaction: Native selects and checkboxes keep keyboard semantics; system preference is respected; sound stays off until activation.
views.mobile: Controls wrap into a small panel with native-sized targets; long labels remain visible.
views.motion: Palette changes are immediate to avoid low-contrast cross-fades.

views.composition: A simple chronological list uses Fraunces release headings and Figtree explanation; technical details remain native disclosures.
views.hierarchy: Product meaning, version/date, then optional implementation details and feed navigation.
views.interaction: Empty list remains useful; details open with keyboard; feed returns to the release page.
views.mobile: One readable column with no timeline ornament or tiny metadata columns.
views.motion: No card entrances or hover disclosure.

views.composition: A readable feed-entry specimen preserves plain title/date/description rather than pretending to own the external reader.
views.hierarchy: Release title and text before the route back to Linejam.
views.interaction: Empty feed and populated entries have visible states; external feed-reader UI is not fabricated.
views.mobile: Plain text wraps without special art or app navigation inside the feed body.
views.motion: No feed motion.
views.copy: A readable stand-in for an external RSS reader.

views.composition: A small confused twig and direct recovery sheet replace the enormous blurred error stamp.
views.hierarchy: Where you are and a route home matter more than a theatrical 404.
views.interaction: The safe home action does not guess another private route.
views.mobile: Ordinary page flow keeps large text and browser navigation available.
views.motion: No stamp, scaling number or environmental animation.

views.composition: A self-contained recovery sheet acknowledges that this page failed without covering navigation in a fixed decorative overlay.
views.hierarchy: Specific failure and Try again, then home.
views.interaction: Retry operates the local state sketch; production reset remains a user action.
views.mobile: One reachable error action pair in natural flow.
views.motion: No fade-up that hides the error temporarily.

views.composition: A deliberately simple text-and-button sheet can be understood without the full brand runtime; familiar green is supplementary.
views.hierarchy: Application failure and retry; no provider or account assumption.
views.interaction: The emergency composition does not fabricate an active room or lost poems.
views.mobile: Large plain text and ordinary native buttons survive an incomplete stylesheet.
views.motion: No motion dependency at the root failure boundary.

views.composition: An original invitation poster pairs the curling logo and large Fraunces invitation with the eccentric botanical edge and truthful nine-line shape.
views.hierarchy: Linejam, one clear promise, shape; no tiny app screenshot.
views.interaction: Light artwork is independent of the current app theme; fallback system fonts must preserve hierarchy.
views.mobile: The web specimen reflows; intended fixed social composition keeps the same simple left/right structure.
views.motion: A static image by definition.

views.composition: The authorized public specimen preview is distinct from a generic private fallback, with no human text carried across access states.
views.hierarchy: Public words only after consent; unavailable preview presents identity and privacy instead.
views.interaction: Pending/private/revoked/unavailable states use brand-only content; full downloaded images are separate.
views.mobile: Text-first preview can truncate only in fixed social artwork, never in the complete poem view.
views.motion: No social-preview animation.

views.composition: An explicitly public set becomes a small two-column collection beneath a strong shared heading; unavailable sets show only identity.
views.hierarchy: Gathering title and public previews before counts; no crowned poem or leaderboard.
views.interaction: Public and unavailable branches remain distinct; individual full artifacts are separate from compact social composition.
views.mobile: Web specimen stacks; the intended fixed social artwork limits previews rather than shrinking text to illegibility.
views.motion: A static set preview.

components.treatment: Open pale-green field and one consistent task sheet; the curling mark identifies a continuous human game rather than an account dashboard.
components.states: Guest/local and connected-account boundaries, readable light/dark and print baseline; only one visual owner for provider wrappers.
components.accessibility: Native landmarks, skip link, no remote font dependency, natural zoom/reflow and a focusable main.

components.treatment: Compact Fraunces Linejam with a sprig at the left; literal text utilities replace ambiguous miniature icons.
components.states: Home, poems, help, comfort and identity routes; no fabricated signed-in provider control in guest mode.
components.accessibility: All utilities remain labeled buttons/links with visible 3px focus; wrapping replaces horizontal clipping.

components.treatment: A quiet text line holds releases and a route home; it never competes with the poem.
components.states: Shown as an honest sketch boundary on screen; print hides it; focused production play can omit ancillary links.
components.accessibility: Readable text rather than pale decorative copyright; links have generous hit areas.

components.treatment: The asymmetric botanical edge and oversized unexpected-poem sentence make arrival distinct in grayscale.
components.states: New guest and returning collection paths use the same decisive host/join pair.
components.accessibility: Meaning is carried by literal actions and the accessible nine-round shape, never illustration alone.

components.treatment: One name sheet with a small outside mushroom; optional companions are secondary and not a setup gate.
components.states: Empty, named, loading, creating and retry states retain the same form geometry.
components.accessibility: Explicit nickname label and helper text, whitespace validation, in-flow submit and autocomplete semantics.

components.treatment: Code then name on a generous white sheet; a direct invitation compresses code entry, not the whole guest welcome.
components.states: Manual normalized code, read-only invitation specimen, loading, joining and error.
components.accessibility: Code Enter moves to name; native labels and invalid state are preserved; long names remain legible.

components.treatment: Phase routing changes the central composition from cast to writing sheet to specimen, not merely the heading of one generic card.
components.states: Lobby, writing, completed, missing, loading and unexpected-state branches receive their actual proposed views.
components.accessibility: The focused main receives phase focus and polite status without reading private content aloud.

components.treatment: A plain recovery sheet refuses to invent a lobby or reveal from an unknown state.
components.states: Unrecognized state explains recovery and offers an explicit home route.
components.accessibility: Native button and ordinary reading order work even without the ornamental art.

components.treatment: Named uneven companion row on one ground line; a separate invitation note prevents tools from dominating people.
components.states: One/eight/ordinary cast, host versus participant, away, pending/error and room tools.
components.accessibility: Names plus text status identify each person; no color-only marks or animation-delayed names.

components.treatment: A compact round strip and one quiet writing sheet replace the social illustration during composition.
components.states: Assignment loading, active composition, no-assignment spectator and accepted waiting are distinct.
components.accessibility: No hidden history, no fixed action covering a phone keyboard, immediate main focus on the next round.

components.treatment: Literal word target, one previous line, large Figtree textarea, count marks and attached Send line.
components.states: Blank/below/exact/above target, 500 characters, first/final round, pending, accepted, restored/offline/error.
components.accessibility: Exact numeric count complements marks; over-target is textual and aria-invalid; long words wrap; only whitespace determines count.

components.treatment: Small acknowledgement sprout followed by a gathered cast, with slow writers neither dimmed into disappearance nor pulsing.
components.states: Loading, some/all ready, away, watching and host-ending confirmation retain explicit words.
components.accessibility: Polite acceptance text and name/status pairs replace continuous visual urgency.

components.treatment: A reader note and an ordered human reading circle, with the entire poem one deliberate action away.
components.states: Assigned, stepping-in, pending, failed, reread, spectator and complete-recap states.
components.accessibility: Every row has literal state and action; no one must infer reader authority from avatar color.

components.treatment: The complete specimen is a full poem on white, with a quiet metadata rule and external reader/actions rail.
components.states: Reveal, reread, archive, public, attribution shown, private favorite, download and print states share the complete text.
components.accessibility: All nine lines remain readable together; names persist in a complete author legend; line text wraps without clipping.

components.treatment: A private collection of equally readable specimens replaces the crowned favorite stage.
components.states: No favorites, private favorite, share/cancel/error, replay, next game, lobby and exit.
components.accessibility: Continue is not visually reserved to a missing host; publication scope precedes its action.

components.treatment: An open shared table makes the same human game legible across a room, with a persistent exit above content.
components.states: Lobby invitation and full-poem reveal presentations, including narrow fallback.
components.accessibility: Readable title and exit survive overflow; content scrolls rather than being clipped to viewport height.

components.treatment: Big code/invitation specimen opposite named botanical people, not a television-only mode.
components.states: Empty/ordinary cast, arrival, away, host and long roster treatment.
components.accessibility: Code is plain text as well as QR; names never rely on color or recent-join animation.

components.treatment: A high-contrast white QR specimen is set inside the plain invitation note with its non-live label and a usable join-form link.
components.states: Original QR fixture encodes SKETCH ONLY; production would encode the real invitation, without theatrical framing.
components.accessibility: Accessible image description and direct text link provide a non-camera alternative; no pretend real room code.

components.treatment: The whole specimen expands to the shared table; its human reader appears above, not in a spotlight over the words.
components.states: Waiting for reader, full active poem, finish, reread and empty overview.
components.accessibility: All nine lines and full author legend remain in reading order; exit never depends on a gesture.

components.treatment: Round information leads; room code and comfort/help utilities are compact, text-labeled secondary actions.
components.states: Code/invitation, tools open, copy/share feedback boundary, appearance and phase status.
components.accessibility: Every popover has a named trigger and Escape/return focus; utilities do not cover the writing sheet.

components.treatment: Comfort remains available beside the single entry task, without reintroducing a full account header.
components.states: Closed and open appearance/sound controls use the same compact plain panel.
components.accessibility: Native inputs, bounded modal scrolling, Escape and restored trigger focus.

components.treatment: Readable light and dark fields are chosen with a native select, plus a device-setting option in Comfort.
components.states: Light/dark/system and OS changes, immediate checked state with no low-contrast color interpolation.
components.accessibility: Native keyboard selection, explicit label and no illustration inversion.

components.treatment: One plain, scrollable rules sheet with the actual word pattern and four literal steps.
components.states: Open/closed, Got it, close, backdrop and Escape; no tutorial gate before writing.
components.accessibility: Focus trap, inert outside content, body scroll lock and trigger restoration.

components.treatment: A bordered, in-flow notice uses a plain connection sentence and retained-draft explanation.
components.states: Initially hidden, offline, reconnecting and restored; no false accepted-state claim.
components.accessibility: Polite status or error role, no focus theft and no overlap with text input.

components.treatment: A restrained update notice explains why refreshing matters and leaves the decision with the user.
components.states: Hidden when no known mismatch; persistent update and deliberate refresh when known.
components.accessibility: Text not a colored dot, draft-warning before action, no forced reload animation.

components.treatment: Recovery replaces the failed phase content with a generous note, not a full-screen decorative stamp.
components.states: Loading, caught failure, restore and unexpected state use explicit actions.
components.accessibility: A native retry plus home remains available at large text and without motion.

components.treatment: Guest connection error adopts the entry-sheet grammar and never promotes account creation as its fix.
components.states: Default/custom connection message and retry label; progress-preserving retry.
components.accessibility: Error sentence is announced, retry is labeled, decorative twig remains nonessential.

components.treatment: A truthful local-account sheet explains the browser guest relationship and provides Play as a guest.
components.states: Disconnected sign-in, sign-up and callback; no fake provider form or credential collection.
components.accessibility: Clear distinction between local-game storage and online accounts; ordinary navigation out.

components.treatment: Uneven complete specimen previews, a factual summary and a preservation strip make the archive an object collection rather than a dashboard.
components.states: Loading, empty, guest/account context, populated, favorite failure and public-revoke boundary.
components.accessibility: Persistent Read poem affordances replace hover-only arrows; reading order is linear on phones.

components.treatment: A single wash-colored preservation sentence sits above the specimens, never a large signup advertisement.
components.states: Empty guest, guest with poems, connected collection and local-account-unavailable explanations.
components.accessibility: Storage provenance is literal; optional identity navigation does not trap guests.

components.treatment: A compact definition list records poems, favorites, co-writers and authored lines with no medals.
components.states: Real-shaped static specimen counts, singular/plural intent and empty/loading counterparts.
components.accessibility: Each value has a definition label; numbers are facts rather than competitive scores.

components.treatment: One large but quiet Fraunces value follows its ordinary Figtree noun, with no icon or accent hierarchy implying merit.
components.states: Ordinary and emphasized factual totals; no fabricated live statistics.
components.accessibility: Definition-list semantics make the association explicit without visual position.

components.treatment: Three quiet strokes and a specific loading sentence reserve space without invented values.
components.states: Pending stats contain no zero counts that could be misread as empty data.
components.accessibility: Busy/status semantics and no repeating pulse.

components.treatment: A plain specimen preview exposes actual synthetic text and a persistent Read poem link; favorite sits outside link semantics.
components.states: Default/featured, focused, favorite/pending/error and public-revoke boundary.
components.accessibility: No nested clickable controls, no hover-only metadata, long lines and names wrap.

components.treatment: A stable white specimen outline holds the nine-line-shaped space while announcing what is loading.
components.states: Pending data uses placeholder bars, never fake lines or names.
components.accessibility: Bars are hidden from assistive technology; one polite busy message replaces pulsing animation.

components.treatment: A small twig beside a specific invitation replaces an empty gallery of gray boxes.
components.states: Default empty offers start/join; component-only filtered state says no matches without inventing a search workflow.
components.accessibility: Empty state has meaningful next actions, not just decorative absence.

components.treatment: Nine short rounded marks retain the true widening/narrowing word-count shape, always fully visible.
components.states: Small through large and empty ghost variants remain the same truthful structure.
components.accessibility: An explicit accessible 1,2,3,4,5,4,3,2,1 label accompanies the static shape.

components.treatment: Retire the unused separate compact export and show the retained simple shape as its replacement specimen.
components.states: Explicitly unused/retired; not falsely presented as a mounted archive feature.
components.accessibility: No duplicate inaccessible mini visualization or hover-dependent bars.

components.treatment: Replace anonymous tiny colored dots with named Seed/Leaf/Mushroom/Twig silhouettes and a complete contributor list.
components.states: Ordinary and overflow contributors expand into text rather than an unexplained +N color group.
components.accessibility: Names identify people; silhouette and optional color are supplementary.

components.treatment: Retire the unused gradient underline; show the same named contributor row as the non-color-only alternative.
components.states: Empty remains absent; retired export is not assigned a fabricated route.
components.accessibility: No color-only inline attribution; full names remain readable.

components.treatment: Permission-safe route states wrap the complete specimen, not a second competing poem layout.
components.states: Loading, pending sharing, participant, public, private/unavailable, favorite and revoke.
components.accessibility: No private line or author appears in safe fallbacks; action labels describe actual permission scope.

components.treatment: A public set is one sequential collection of complete specimen articles with all attribution, followed by native export and entry links.
components.states: Authorized whole set and unavailable fallback; no fake partial private-preview collection.
components.accessibility: Each poem is an article; print removes app controls without removing authors.

components.treatment: A plain Export complete set as PDF action supplies two explicit fictional poem specimens to browser print, never a retained private sketch.
components.states: Idle and native handoff only; no fabricated custom PDF modal or saved-success claim.
components.accessibility: Visible text explains the browser-owned action and works from keyboard.

components.treatment: An optional-account sheet with one quiet botanical outside edge; phone layout keeps the account truth ahead of decorative specimens.
components.states: Connected-provider design boundary and disconnected local guest continuation.
components.accessibility: No form fields collecting credentials when no provider is connected.

components.treatment: Account availability is stated directly inside the generous entry sheet; native provider security would keep this typography and focus treatment.
components.states: Local disconnected state is real to the sketch; provider sign-in/recovery remains unclaimed external UI.
components.accessibility: Play as guest is prominent and does not require completing an account step.

components.treatment: The optional account sheet uses preservation language, never an achievement or garden-growth reward.
components.states: Local disconnected state; connected-provider signup/OTP/error boundary is explicit rather than mocked.
components.accessibility: No provider claims or credential harvesting; same native input/error typography contract.

components.treatment: A quiet transfer-status sheet distinguishes loading from migration failure and preserves the guest route.
components.states: Completing, failed transfer, retry, go home and disconnected-account fallback.
components.accessibility: One busy status; retained-progress explanation before retry; no animation-dependent redirect claim.

components.treatment: A full white specimen demonstrates the outcome using explicitly synthetic text in the sketch and only opted-in public text in production.
components.states: Synthetic example, loading and empty; not a source of private preview content.
components.accessibility: Full text and authors remain readable; illustration never becomes the account form background.

components.treatment: Name-first identity sheet with one stable optional botanical companion and storage provenance.
components.states: Guest alias, long name, account-management boundary and local-account explanation.
components.accessibility: No forced avatar, no hover color requirement, no invented editable provider profile form.

components.treatment: Chronological text articles replace a gallery of product-update cards.
components.states: Loaded, empty and feed navigation use ordinary language and optional technical detail.
components.accessibility: Semantic headings and native disclosures retain keyboard reading order.

components.treatment: Fraunces title, small readable date and Figtree explanation; one border communicates chronology rather than dashboard containment.
components.states: Product prose present/absent and technical detail closed/open.
components.accessibility: No hover reveal; the title and date are text, not image labels.

components.treatment: A native disclosure keeps implementation categories below the product explanation.
components.states: Collapsed/expanded with grouped interface/accessibility notes and scope when needed.
components.accessibility: Keyboard Enter/Space, visible focus and native disclosure state.

components.treatment: A plain recovery sheet and small twig replace the oversized blurred numerical stamp.
components.states: Unknown/private-public-recap fallback with Return home.
components.accessibility: Natural page flow survives large text and has no animation-delayed error copy.

components.treatment: A concise failure explanation and retry action make recovery the composition.
components.states: Caught failure and user-triggered reset, with a separate home exit.
components.accessibility: No fixed full-screen overlay or focusless retry; error text is immediately visible.

components.treatment: A deliberately minimal error heading and native retry can survive before theme providers initialize.
components.states: Root failure without fictional room or account state.
components.accessibility: System font fallback and plain controls remain sufficient; identity art is optional.

components.treatment: A deep-green, softly squared primary action and quieter white secondary establish hierarchy without shadows or nested outlines.
components.states: Primary, secondary, text, disabled, pending and acknowledged states; no looping ready ring.
components.accessibility: At least 48px target, visible 3px focus, native disabled semantics and clear verb labels.

components.treatment: Generous white Figtree fields with dark-green labels, one border and a distinct focus outline.
components.states: Empty, filled, read-only, disabled, invalid, long name and code normalization.
components.accessibility: Real labels and described errors; text scaling and long values do not shrink the font.

components.treatment: Plain sentence-case labels identify controls; a small bordered pill distinguishes non-form status metadata.
components.states: Form label, helper text, error-associated label and private-status chip.
components.accessibility: A real label uses for/id; status styling never pretends to supply missing label semantics.

components.treatment: One vertical border and a specific title/message explain what changed; muted wash for information, readable rose for error.
components.states: Success, retained-draft information, warning and actionable error.
components.accessibility: Text and role carry severity in grayscale; no sound or mascot expression is required.

components.treatment: Four original odd botanical silhouettes are optional, with a visible name and shape label always present.
components.states: Seed, Leaf, Mushroom, Twig; selected/unselected, long name, here/away/line-in.
components.accessibility: Named buttons with aria-pressed; color is supplementary and companions confer no traits or rewards.

components.treatment: A small sun-colored Host tag identifies authority without a crown motif.
components.states: Host present, transferred ownership and readable dark mode.
components.accessibility: The literal word Host carries meaning; no crown competes with personal favorites.

components.treatment: A static incomplete ring accompanies the exact loading action in ordinary text.
components.states: Preparing, joining, opening poem and generic pending.
components.accessibility: Polite busy status, no endless pulse, no decorative text substituting for real status.

components.treatment: A small outlined clock and gentle pacing sentence replace an animated draining line.
components.states: Time available, overtime Take your time and no-start absence.
components.accessibility: Never gates sending and never announces every second; text makes pacing optional.

components.treatment: One tiny sprout settle acknowledges arrival with the full name already in place.
components.states: Default final state and a deliberate replay of the one-time acknowledgement.
components.accessibility: No stagger delay or hidden name; reduced motion keeps the complete static companion.

components.treatment: Small in-place count marks support the numeric count, not duplicate every typed word as a distracting chip cloud.
components.states: Blank/below/exact/above target and bounded overflow; exact count is literal.
components.accessibility: One visible numeric status, aria-invalid on over-target input, long tokens remain in the wrapping textarea.

components.treatment: A plain labeled private-heart button is a bookmark, not a communal winner signal.
components.states: Unselected, selected, unknown/pending and visible failure retaining prior state.
components.accessibility: aria-pressed and a readable saved state; no heart color alone, no crown sound.

components.treatment: An original sprig wordmark and the eccentric cast form an invitation poster with large type and the true word shape.
components.states: Fixed-light intended composition and font-fallback hierarchy.
components.accessibility: No private content, stock art or tiny unreadable interface screenshot.

components.treatment: An explicitly public specimen preview is a different artifact from the private full-image download.
components.states: Authorized teaser versus safe generic fallback; fixed social boundaries never truncate in-app full text.
components.accessibility: Permission gate precedes text/names; static artwork has an equivalent textual title.

components.treatment: Brand-only message and the cast remain when a poem is private, pending, revoked or unavailable.
components.states: All inaccessible states reveal no poem first line, teaser or contributor identity.
components.accessibility: The privacy boundary is readable, not signaled only by a lock icon.

components.treatment: A clean complete-image specimen includes every line and every unique author, with intentional light/dark fills and no texture.
components.states: Local SVG download, long-line wrapping, saving/handoff and error feedback.
components.accessibility: No clipped human text; browser owns file outcome; the same content remains available as HTML.

components.treatment: A static public two-column miniature collection expresses shared authorship without a crowned favorite.
components.states: Explicit public set and brand-only unavailable fallback.
components.accessibility: Privacy-safe preview, readable title and no live-publication claim in the sketch.

motion.timing: Immediate stable state. Removed effects have no latent animation or inherited delay.

motion.timing: Immediate stable state. Removed effects have no latent animation or inherited delay.

motion.choreography: The complete 1–2–3–4–5–4–3–2–1 silhouette is always visible, never drawn on hover.

motion.timing: Immediate stable state. Removed effects have no latent animation or inherited delay.
